info.headline: Flood Warning for Upper Onkaparinga River above Verdun, Onkaparinga River at Woodside and Onkaparinga River at Oakbank
info.description:
Minor flooding has eased along the Upper Onkaparinga River above Verdun.
The Onkaparinga River at Woodside is currently at 0.95 m and falling, below the minor flood level. The Onkaparinga River at Woodside is likely to remain below the minor flood level (2.00 m).
The Onkaparinga River at Oakbank is currently at 1.05 m and falling, below the minor flood level. The Onkaparinga River at Oakbank is likely to remain below the minor flood level (1.17 m).
info.instruction:
* Don't drive, walk, swim or play in floodwater because it is dangerous. * Stay away from flooded drains, rivers, streams and waterways. * Obey road closure signs. Plan ahead so you don't drive on flooded roads. * Check the ABC and local media for updates. The situation can change quickly, so stay informed. * For local emergency management warnings and advice visit www.ses.sa.gov.au/incidents-and-warnings/incidents-and-warnings-map/.
For emergency assistance call SES on telephone number 132 500. In life-threatening emergencies, call 000 (triple zero) immediately.

info.headline: Minor Flood Warning for Lower Onkaparinga River below Mt Bold Reservoir and Onkaparinga River at Clarendon Weir
info.description:
Minor flooding is possible along the Onkaparinga River at Clarendon Weir.
The Onkaparinga River at Clarendon Weir is currently at 11.02 m and rising, below the minor flood level. The Onkaparinga River at Clarendon Weir may exceed the minor flood level (11.20 m) early Tuesday morning. Further rises are possible.
